patch.sql:
select
    o_orderkey as order_key,
    o_customer_key as customer_key,
    o_orderstatus as order_status,
    o_totalprice as total_price,
    o_orderdate as order_date,
    o_orderpriority as priority,
    _loaded_at as loaded_at
from {{ source('raw', 'orders') }}
patch.explanation: The stg_orders model referenced column "o_custkey" which does not exist in raw.orders (the column is named o_customer_key). This caused a Binder Error during the dbt build. Updating the model to use the correct column name fixes the runtime error and all downstream checks now pass.
